notes: Genelec 1032A official datasheet (BBA32001a, 6.2000): free-field response 42 Hz–21 kHz ±2.5 dB; bass amplifier 180 W (4 Ω) + treble amplifier 120 W (8 Ω) short-term, summed per the 1031A convention (300 W); 10 in bass driver + 1 in metal dome; crossover 1.8 kHz. No sensitivity or passive impedance is published for this powered monitor; those stay N/A.

Genelec 1029A official datasheet (BBA29001a, 1.2003): free-field response 70 Hz–18 kHz ±2.5 dB; bass 40 W + treble 40 W amplifiers into 8 Ω, summed per the 1031A convention (80 W); 5 in bass driver + 3/4 in metal dome; crossover 3.3 kHz. No sensitivity or passive impedance is published for this powered monitor; those stay N/A.
